# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 88 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 49-50 | Coptic

---

## Saying 88

Jesus said: "The angels and the prophets will come to you and will give you what belongs to you. And you in turn, give them what you have, and say among yourselves: 'On what day will they come and take what is theirs?'"

---

**Translator's Notes (LOGOS):**

- "Angels" — in this context the divine messengers may be angels specifically
- "What belongs to you" — more idiomatic than "what is yours"
- "In turn" — the reciprocity of the exchange
- "Take what is theirs" — receiving their due
